_meta.purpose: Hover-card data for the committee node maps on the 'Who we sell to, sector by sector' slide. Keyed product.sector.role so nodes can be wired directly.
_meta.sources: Apollo pull Aug 6 2026 against ICP evidence accounts; Stars buying-committee pull; Aug 5 back-office buyer research
_meta.photo_field: Path relative to the deploy folder. Sourced from Apollo and downloaded locally so nothing hotlinks an expiring LinkedIn CDN URL. null where the person has no profile photo; the card falls back to initials.
_meta.weights: QO runs one scale on every tab: economic buyer 92, evaluator 88, champion 72, gatekeeper 58. Banking and retail champions run 66 because neither carries a penalty node. BOO weights are the slide's existing 96 / 78 / 66 / 42.
_meta.bands: Both products use the walk-away floor (200) as the band floor. QO sweet spot 5,000 - 15,000 carried once at slide level, not per tab.
decisions: QO runs five tabs: healthcare payers, insurance, banking and financial services, telecom, BPO and shared services.
Large retail sits inside the BPO tab as the no-penalty variant. Home Depot carries zero penalty-bearing queues, so it does not headline a tab.
BOO gatekeeper node relabelled per tab to the real function, replacing 'IT Security'. Weight unchanged at 42.
BOO champion node relabelled per tab, since 'Quality / Stars lead' only holds in healthcare.
_meta.install_base: ib flag marks accounts where Intradiem already owns the front office. Badged on the node.
_meta.headline_field: Live LinkedIn headline as of 2026-08-06, shown on the hover card.
_meta.retired_field: true where LinkedIn shows the person as retired or out of the seat. The hover card renders a re-verify warning. Michele Cleary (RBC), Ken Solon (Prudential), Bridget Reidy (Exelon), Sylvie Duquette (Rogers).
corrections_2026_08_06: Point32Health set to ib:false. It is absent from greenlight-pack/Active_Customers_SF_Jul10.csv (the 101-row Salesforce active-customer export) and was previously flagged inconsistently across tabs.
IB flags on all other nodes verified against that same Salesforce export: 20 of 21 companies are active customers, so near-universal IB is correct by design, not a bug.
OPEN: "US Bank / Elavon" matches US Bancorp in Salesforce, but Elavon is a subsidiary, so that node inherits its IB claim from the parent. Unresolved.
_meta.lanes: Two lanes per tab. nodes = install base (accounts already running Intradiem). nn_nodes = net new (accounts never sold to). Identical structure: same sectors, same four roles, same influence weights.
_meta.customer_exclusion: Every net-new account validated against greenlight-pack/Active_Customers_SF_Jul10.csv (101-row Salesforce export). Zero current customers appear on the net-new lane. The check caught UnitedHealth Group, Humana, CVS Health, Elevance, Molina and HCSC sitting inside the Tier A/B net-new account file, and Guardian Life and Molina inside sourcing results.
_meta.seat_currency: Contacts whose LinkedIn showed they had left the seat were replaced with the person currently holding it: Michele Cleary to Kristina Maxwell-Smith (RBC), Ken Solon to Greg Hafner (Prudential), Bridget Reidy to Mike Innocenzo (Exelon), Sylvie Duquette to Scott Thomson (Rogers).
open_items: "US Bank / Elavon" matches US Bancorp in the Salesforce export, but Elavon is a subsidiary, so that node inherits its install-base status from the parent.

utilities.operation: Billing and meter-to-cash, customer operations, work management, service delivery and regulatory reporting.
triggers: Regulatory SLA targets on billing accuracy and complaint resolution
Storm or outage driven volume spikes
Overstaffing buffers held to cover peaks
utilities.not_a_fit: Under 200 agents. Generation and field crews, which are not case based.
utilities.note: Search trap for reps: "resource planning" in a utility usually means power generation planning, not people. Search workforce planning and meter-to-cash titles instead.
